description: This file provides a Go implementation for interacting with cgroups v2 on Linux systems, including functions to detect cgroup version, parse cgroup data, and retrieve CPU quota information for the current process.

classes.name: CGroups2
classes.description: Provides access to cgroups v2 data, including CPU quota information.

methods.name: NewCGroups2ForCurrentProcess
methods.description: Creates a CGroups2 instance for the current process, returning an error if cgroups v2 is not used.

methods.name: CPUQuota
methods.description: Returns the CPU quota as a float, a boolean indicating if quota is set, and an error if any.
